Yes, 4 people qualifies. LNER's small group saving gives 20% off Advance tickets for groups of 3 to 9. It applies automatically when you book them together in one booking, and the group is seated together. It can't be combined with Railcards. The terms say you must travel together the whole way.

https://www.lner.co.uk/tickets/offers-and-discounts/savings-for-small-groups/
